lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity, roughly circular pixel clusters are arranged in a multi-row grid posterior to the gill slits. The arrangement exhibits roughly equidistant spacing between local maxima within the central flank area.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance are visible, intersecting with the horizontal rows of spots to form a grid-like pattern where the spots occupy the intersection nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct longitudinal ridge is visible in the upper third of the flank, manifesting as a sharp luminance transition with higher pixel values on the dorsal side and a corresponding shadow gradient immediately below.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small notch is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the pectoral fin. Several dark, high-contrast focal points are distributed across the mid-lateral skin, consistent with minor lesions or ectoparasites.
other_distinctive_markers: Two elongated, low-luminance silhouettes are visible in the lower left quadrant beneath the pectoral fin, indicating the presence of commensal organisms.
